_note: Six nodes per element. 'requires' lists node ids; 'requires_any' true means one of them is enough. A node either unlocks an ability slot ('unlock'), changes ability stats ('mods': mult or add), or gives a passive ('passive': hp_mult, speed_mult, chi_regen_mult, chi_max_add). The basic attack is always unlocked.

fire.name: Flame Fan
fire.desc: Unlock RMB: a fan of five fire bolts.

fire.name: Flame Dash
fire.desc: Unlock Q: a quick dash that can't be hit.

fire.name: Wide Fan
fire.desc: Flame Fan fires 7 bolts and recharges 1 s sooner.

fire.name: Inferno Ring
fire.desc: Unlock R: a ring of fire that burns and throws back everyone near you.

water.name: Ice Spike
water.desc: Unlock RMB: a fast spike of ice that nearly freezes its target.

water.name: Healing Tide
water.desc: Unlock Q: heal 30 HP over 4 seconds.

water.name: Deep Freeze
water.desc: Ice Spike hits 40% harder and slows for longer.

water.name: Flowing Spirit
water.desc: 20% more HP and Healing Tide heals 15 more.

water.name: Tidal Wave
water.desc: Unlock R: a huge wave that rolls through everything in its path.

earth.name: Stone Wall
earth.desc: Unlock RMB: raise a wall of stone that blocks shots for 6 seconds.

earth.name: Seismic Stomp
earth.desc: Unlock Q: shake the ground around you, hurting and slowing.

earth.name: Bedrock
earth.desc: Stone Wall is wider, lasts 4 s longer and recharges 2 s sooner.

earth.name: Boulder Barrage
earth.desc: Unlock R: hurl three huge boulders at once.

air.name: Gust Spiral
air.desc: Unlock RMB: a long, fast gust that shoves its target away.

air.name: Wide Blast
air.desc: Air Blast reaches 40% farther and pushes harder.

air.name: Air Leap
air.desc: Unlock Q: leap high and far in the direction you move.

air.name: Tornado
air.desc: Unlock R: a spinning tornado that drags enemies in.
